title: Guru Purnima
intro: A verse from the Bhagavad Gita on learning from the wise, for Guru Purnima.

posts.caption: For many, today is Guru Purnima, the full moon of Ashadha, when teachers are honoured. It is also called Vyasa Purnima, after the sage Vyasa, traditionally the compiler of the Vedas and author of the Mahabharata, which contains the Gita. Krishna names three ways to learn from the wise: reverence (pranipata), questioning and service (seva).
